item.title: Illustrator and Layered Fonts
item.description:
I’m working on a layered font family and everything is great in InDesign, but the alignment is off by about 1 or 2 vertical points in Illustrator when I switch between styles. Does anyone know if this is normal?

I’m a little nervous to release a font that doesn’t “line up” in all programs.

item.title: Can I align numerals in Freight Sans
item.description: Can anyone help here? I’m trying to persuade a client to use Freight Sans which I believe fits better with their brand, however they’ve got hung up on the non-aligning numerals and I can’t seem to find an easy way to set them aligned in our print. Maybe it’s not possible… if that’s the case, does anyone have a work around or any ideas to help sell them back to the client?!
